2rc2dk:182: . The central insight of this article lies in revealing the multi-agent architecture philosophy of "specialization over versatility." When a single Agent attempts to take on all functions, it simultaneously encounters context pollution (attention scattered across heterogeneous tasks), skill conflicts (the principle of least privilege is violated), and persona conflicts (drastically different behavior patterns are hard to coexist). npjlve:210: . The author divides OpenClaw's memory into three levels: short-term (session context), mid-term (work journal from recent days), and long-term (knowledge accumulation across sessions). This design directly corresponds to the trichotomy of working memory, episodic memory, and semantic memory in human cognition. Traditional monolithic Agents lack a stable memory persistence mechanism, causing every session to start from zero; the three-layer memory architecture, in contrast, enables Agents to accumulate experience and achieve genuinely continuous work. This point is repeatedly emphasized in the configurations of both the investment assistant and the development assistant — both take "remembering work patterns" as a core configuration goal.
